theorem: The map rho->M_rho is typed and D12-covariant: M_{g rho}=g M_rho g^{-1}. For a nonuniform strict heat state it generically satisfies [A,M_rho]!=0, so alternating A and M_rho layers distinguish their order; the scaled small-step difference converges to the commutator norm by BCH. For the invariant state rho=1/12, M_rho is scalar and the effect vanishes. Thus the state-to-multiplication map supplies a genuine conditional second operator, while the localized preparation delta_0 is exactly the additional symmetry-breaking resource.
typed_map: rho in the vertex-state simplex maps to M_rho=diag(rho) in the vertex multiplication algebra
